title: Canadian Corn Wrap
description: A flavorful and crunchy wrap filled with juicy corn, crispy jagged bacon, and fresh vegetables, perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Grill the corn for 10-12 minutes, turning frequently, until slightly charred and tender.
3. Meanwhile, cook the jagged bacon in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
4. In a large bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise and shredded cheese.
5. Add the diced red onion and cilantro to the bowl and stir to combine.
6. Warm the tortilla wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
7. Assemble the wrap by spreading the mayonnaise mixture on the tortilla, followed by the grilled corn, crispy bacon, and a sprinkle of cheese.
